goals.title: G1 Runtime probes on AGY 1.2.2: install plugin from the 44G worktree,...
goals.objective: G1 Runtime probes on AGY 1.2.2: install plugin from the 44G worktree, agy plugin validate, agent registry contents, OQ-6 inheritCustomizations live probes for native-subagent paths (Steamroller-primary to Zen, Bobcat to Strix Halo nested, runner-invoked default session to Bobcat), agy --agent acceptance of subagent roles, live hook marker enforcement for both guards; durable evidence for every probe. G2 Activation wiring on vnext/44g-activation: spine CLI driver exposing ledger transitions with the Zen review split so Steamroller invokes Zen host-natively, activated Steamroller frontmatter per G1 results, clean-room re-author of agents/excavator.md and hooks/excavator-shell-guard.py and plugin.json from the two spec docs only, hooks.json Excavator registration confirmed, all unit tests green. G3 Live integration validation of the full vNext stack on a scratch project: multi-milestone progression, Bulldozer DONE not equal project completion, Zen NO-GO then repair then fresh GO, material replan increments plan_version and stales verdicts, fresh-context resume, Steamroller-only ledger authority, Bobcat/Jaguar/Puma/Strix boundary enforcement, Zen mutation block, wrong or stale result_ref rejection, correct failure and BLOCKED escalation; captured evidence per scenario. G4 Provenance closure for all 15 contract surfaces with evidence refs, AGENTS.md final vNext activation form prepared, explicit Sonnet/Instinct deferral recorded with reason, full test suite plus agy plugin validate green. G5 Independent gate review of the complete 44G diff and evidence; only on APPROVE create the activation-ready commit, push vnext/44g-activation, open the PR, and write the final report; no activation commit before APPROVE; never merge main.

goals.evidence: G1 complete: plugin install+validate exit 0, registry captured, OQ-6 resolved on AGY 1.2.2 (runner bypass proven live, primary->subagent works with tools, nested bobcat->strix works, invoke_subagent is the enforced boundary, --agent is loose, tools:[] strips model-visible surface, hooks marker-scoped + deny-set-scoped, customization isolation behaviorally confirmed). goals.title: G2 Activation wiring on vnext/44g-activation

successCriteria.capturedEvidence: spine-cli.mjs exposes init/status/delegate/run-milestone/candidate/record-zen/blocked/replan/resolve-blocker/complete/invoke-role; two-milestone run reached candidate-persisted + promoted state with result_ref bound (G3 live run).

goals.title: G3 Live integration validation of full vNext stack
goals.objective: Run live AGY validation of the complete vNext stack on a scratch project with the worktree plugin installed: multi-milestone progression; Bulldozer DONE != project completion; Zen NO-GO -> repair -> fresh Zen GO; material replan -> plan_version increment -> prior verdicts STALE; fresh-context resume from ledger; Steamroller-only authoritative ledger/global completion; Bobcat/Jaguar/Puma/Strix role-boundary enforcement; Zen mutation block via NTG_ZEN_VERIFY guard; wrong/stale result_ref rejection; correct failure/BLOCKED escalation. Capture durable evidence per scenario under the evidence worktree.

successCriteria.scenario: Live multi-milestone run: a scripted scratch project driven through the real spine CLI + real agy invocations completes milestone one (Bulldozer DONE -> candidate persisted -> real Zen GO -> promoted) then milestone two; PASS = ledger JSON shows both completed with matching result_refs and plan_version, and declareGlobalCompletion succeeds only after both.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Full run transcript + ledger JSON snapshots per transition + Zen verdict packets, saved under evidence dir.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Multi-milestone live run: M1+M2 both DONE->candidate->Zen GO->promoted via run-milestone (bulldozer->bobcat->zen real agy calls); completed=[M1,M2]; declareGlobalCompletion succeeded. Ledger snapshots + transcripts under g3-live/transcripts/.

successCriteria.scenario: Adversarial live scenarios: (a) Zen NO-GO on a deliberately defective candidate -> milestone stays incomplete -> repair -> fresh GO with new result_ref; (b) material replan -> plan_version increments, prior GO marked STALE, old-version verdict rejected; (c) forged/stale result_ref verdict rejected; (d) fresh-context resume from ledger file alone; PASS = each rejection/stale/resume observed in ledger + transcripts.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Per-scenario transcripts + ledger diffs showing NO-GO record, STALE marking, rejection errors, and resumed completion.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Adversarial: (a) defective candidate -> Zen NO-GO (content mismatch observed) -> repair -> fresh GO with new result_ref; (b) replan v1->v2, M1 verdict STALE, completed cleared; (c) stale verdict rejected StaleVerdictError, forged result_ref rejected MismatchedResultRefError; (d) resume loads ledger post-replan with correct next_action. Ledger fix: materialReplan clears evidence[*].active_candidate.

successCriteria.scenario: Role-boundary live probes: Bobcat attempting a non-Strix subagent invocation is refused/blocked; Zen attempting a mutation command is denied by the hook; Bulldozer attempting ledger write or Zen invocation is rejected by spine; PASS = observed refusals captured.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Probe transcripts showing the denial/error for each boundary violation attempt.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Boundaries: Zen marked rm denied by hook (file intact). FINDING: bobcat->jaguar invoke_subagent is NOT runtime-enforced (prompt-level only) — recorded as a contract finding. agy --agent <subagent> does not load role body (silent default fallback).

goals.evidence: G3 complete: multi-milestone (M1+M2 GO, completed, declareGlobalCompletion), DONE!=completion, NO-GO->repair->fresh GO, replan v1->v2 + stale verdicts, resume, Steamroller-only ledger authority, Zen mutation block, stale/wrong-ref rejections, BLOCKED escalation. Findings: bobcat->jaguar prompt-level only; agy --agent doesn't load role body; agy sandboxes relative writes. Evidence: g3-live/ (85 files).
